title: Bee Removal in Mineola, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Mineola, Long Island. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
intro: Active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Mineola property? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging insect nest treatment and removal throughout Nassau County. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it directly through the entry point, remove accessible nest material, and seal every opening to prevent recolonization. We treat wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — honeybee colonies are referred to a licensed beekeeper.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over 15 years of experience serving Mineola and surrounding Long Island communities with expert bee removal services. Our trained specialists use safe, eco-friendly methods to relocate bee colonies while ensuring your property is completely protected, all at competitive rates of $350 - $550.
localContext: Mineola's tree-lined streets, historic homes near Winthrop University Hospital, and bustling downtown business district create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in eaves, chimneys, wall voids, and soffits. From the residential neighborhoods around Mineola Boulevard to commercial properties near the LIRR station, paper wasp nests under eaves and yellow jacket colonies in wall cavities are common structural problems that require professional treatment and entry-point sealing.

faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

We understand the urgency and work quickly to restore safety to your property.
